proposals.evidence: Turner explicitly separates the ḍa extension of carman and lists Gujarati cāmḍũ/cāmḍī and Marathi cāmḍẽ/cāmḍī hide/skin. The western survey forms fit this extended family, with s for c and retroflex flap/stop variants retained; cāmbḍɔ includes the transitional labial stop in the mḍ cluster. The specific attested extension is used, not the separately inferred generic ḍ node.
